title: Assessment of Endothelial Function in Patients With Non Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease and the Impact of Statin Treatment

sections.abstract: The aim of the current study is to evaluate the association of fatty liver severity and endothelial function in Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD) patients and to find the impact of statin treatment compared to usual care or life style modification on endothelial function, liver steatosis and fibrosis.
